definition: Techniques for embedding a detectable signal into AI-generated content (text, images, audio) to allow later identification of its AI origin.
details: Watermarking is explored as one approach to help distinguish AI-generated content from human-created content, supporting transparency and combating misuse like disinformation, though robustness against removal remains a technical challenge.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Think of it as the quiet rule that a tool should be useful without being dangerous. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Watermarking (AI-generated content).
